continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: User requested CPU/RSS realism and iptables overhead. Current exact WBD smoke run 32814277618 used udp2raw -a and therefore is not literally firewall-free, but its cpu_ms_total only sums WBD userspace process CPU and does not capture OpenWrt-style routed FORWARD/NAT kernel work or all softirq cost. The current local sandbox lacks CAP_NET_ADMIN, so it cannot install real iptables rules or create veth/netns. A compiled C UDP relay upper-bound test was run locally: 100000 x 1200-byte echo transactions, five repeats; direct median ~1467.9 Mbps, one relay ~1200.2 Mbps with ~710 ms relay CPU for 200000 forwarded datagrams (~3.55 us/datagram) and ~1412 KiB RSS; two relays ~403.3 Mbps with ~2130 ms CPU and ~2832 KiB RSS. Because a userspace relay exaggerates netfilter cost, scripts/bench_netfilter_overhead.py plus tests/test_netfilter_bench_optional.py were added to run a privileged client-router-server comparison of plain routing, FORWARD+conntrack and DNAT+MASQUERADE+FORWARD.
